task_description:
Perform the following updates and additions:

1) Moderation sweep across the catalog:
- For every product, find all reviews with moderation_status = "pending".
- Approve any pending review authored by a user whose account_status is "active".
- Reject any pending review authored by a user whose account_status is not active.

2) Urbanite Backpack updates:
- Locate Rajiv Patel’s approved review for the Urbanite Backpack and update it: set rating to 4 and set review_text to "Great capacity and laptop compartment; minor wear on straps after a month."
- Delete all rejected reviews for the Urbanite Backpack.

3) Add a new dietary supplement product:
- Create a new product with:
  - product_id: PRD-005
  - name: NutriWell Vitamin D3
  - category: Dietary Supplements
  - description: "Vitamin D3 softgels for bone and immune support."

4) Seed an initial approved review for the new product:
- For Alice Chan (user_id: USR-a24d), check whether she has already reviewed PRD-005.
  - If she has not, add a review with rating = 4 and review_text = "Noticeable energy improvement after two weeks.", then mark the review approved.
  - If she already has a PRD-005 review, edit her existing review to exactly rating = 4 and review_text = "Noticeable energy improvement after two weeks." and ensure its moderation_status is "approved".

5) Register a new user and add a review:
- Add a new user:
  - user_id: USR-c913
  - username: Maya Lopez
  - account_status: active
- Ensure Maya Lopez has not reviewed the PixelView Action Camera (PRD-003). If she has not, add a review for PRD-003 with rating = 5 and review_text = "Excellent stabilization and clarity even on rocky trails.", then mark the review approved.
